content.short: 0xProcessing helps businesses accept crypto payments, including TON, through checkout flows and API integrations.
content.description: 0xProcessing is a crypto payment gateway built for online businesses that want to accept digital assets at checkout. Its official website and documentation describe merchant tools for handling more than 85 cryptocurrencies across several networks, with payment links, hosted checkout flows, API based integration, and payout support. Within the TON ecosystem, 0xProcessing fits as an infrastructure provider for business payments rather than a personal wallet, trading venue, or consumer finance product.
content.meta: 0xProcessing provides checkout and payment infrastructure for crypto businesses, including TON support.
